notes.title: Bug Update! Oops, I mean Fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I’m still on a bug-hunting mission—some of them hide so deep that reaching them isn’t easy, but progress is steady.
Highlights of this update
Fixed a critical bug that stopped hints on the final level from working.
They now display correctly, so you can finally finish the game!

Some minor bugs.

Thank you for your patience and support. Enjoy the game!
